Our mission is to make healthy living  affordable, convenient and incredibly delicious, thereby helping people in our communities live longer and better lives and we've started on our mission by democratizing healthy food, in what we call THE REAL FOOD REVOLUTION.

Our food is real – it’s made in-house daily by us and is unprocessed, without additives, preservatives or refined sugars and is Organic whenever possible. We like to eat food that is local and responsibly sourced, which means we support nearby farmers, suppliers and artisans who use sustainable methods. We respect many varied diets and offer many dishes that are gluten-free, vegetarian, plant-based and keto.

More than 90% of the products in Honest Greens are plant-based, but we do offer ethically sourced animal proteins that are served in reasonably sized portions and always accompanied by lots of fresh veggies.

You can use our App to:

	• Skip the line or order pick up at all Honest Greens stores
	• Order delivery straight to your door
	• Order daily delivery to your company with privileged pricing with Honest Base
	• Create your own custom dishes
	• Reorder your favourites with ease
	• Honest Rewards - earn with every order
	• Find the closest Honest Greens locations
	• Get early access to new menus

Welcome to Dine by Wix, the app where you can place orders, make reservations and get in contact with your favorite restaurants. With just a few taps of your finger, get everything you need to enjoy a delicious meal whenever and wherever you want it.  

SEAMLESS ORDERING
Easily access and browse the menu of your favorite restaurants and place an order for pickup or delivery. Once you submit your order, you can track your meal so you always know its status. If you’re pressed for time, you can beat the rush by placing your order in advance. 

SECURE PAYMENTS 
Conveniently make a payment directly through the app. You can use a debit or credit card, a 
third party app like PayPal, or pay in cash at the restaurant.  

TABLE RESERVATIONS
Place a reservation when you’re on the go so you can be sure that you have a place at the table. Once your table is confirmed, receive SMS and calendar notifications for your convenience. 

LIVE CHAT
Curious about opening hours, food ingredients, or just have a burning question? Open up a direct line of communication with the restaurant over the live chat feature. Chat on the go and enjoy top-notch customer service wherever you are.

Olio is a local sharing app for passing on things you don’t need to people who live nearby.

From food and clothes to books and toys, turn your useless into someone else’s useful on Olio — and help fight waste. 

Give and get for free; lend and borrow for free; or buy and sell pre-loved items. 

Join a global community of 7 million Olio-ers making a difference in their local communities, and for our planet. 

> Declutter your home, fast: free items usually requested in under 2 hours
> Feel good: 2 in 3 Olio-ers say sharing boosts their mental health
> Do good: Reducing waste is one of the best things you can do to fight climate change

How to use Olio
1: Snap 
Add a photo of your item and set a pick-up location
2: Message
Check your messages and arrange pick up — either on your doorstep, in a public location, or hidden in a safe space
3: Share 
Soak up the good vibes knowing you’ve helped someone local, and the planet

Olio can be used anywhere in the world. Join our ‘share more, waste less’ movement today!
